import { definePrototype } from '@proto.ui/core/authoring';
import type { StateHandle, TaskContext } from '@proto.ui/core/authoring';

function writeChoice(task: TaskContext, state: StateHandle<string>, first: string, last: string, early: boolean): void {
  task.set<string>(state, first);
  if (early) return;
  task.set<string>(state, last);
}

export default definePrototype({
  name: 'task-helper-transaction',
  setup(def) {
    const message = def.state.define<string>('message', { initialize: () => 'waiting' });
    const observed = def.state.define<string>('observed', { initialize: () => 'unread' });
    const copy = def.task<[first: string, last: string, early: boolean], void>(
      'copy', { policy: 'latest' }, async (task, first, last, early) => {
        writeChoice(task, message, first, last, early);
        const staged = task.get<string>(message);
        task.set<string>(message, 'published');
        task.set<string>(observed, staged);
      }
    );
    const created = def.action<[], void>('created', run => { run.start(copy, 'created', 'unreached', true); });
    const submit = def.action<[first: string, last: string, early: boolean], void>(
      'submit', (run, first, last, early) => { run.start(copy, first, last, early); }
    );
    def.lifecycle.onCreated(created);
    def.expose.action('submit', submit);
    def.expose.state('message', message);
    def.expose.state('observed', observed);
    return view => view.el('span', {}, [view.get(message), ' / ', view.get(observed)]);
  },
});
